_source: audit.md §4 (验收标准 4.1 P0 / 4.2 P1) + coordinator ruling 2026-09-21.
_ruling: The coordinator's exclusivity-clean run measured `RecalcStyle/Task = 31-35%`, not the 60% the audit took from the cpuL batch. Absolute values that came from the CONTAMINATED cpuL batch therefore move to `reference` and must not decide PASS/FAIL; relative drops are the primary criteria. Every number is still copied verbatim - nothing is relaxed.

_baseline.window: cpuL, 14 windows. CONTAMINATED: measured with 3 foreign headless_shell instances (cpu-profile/audit.md §0.1). Its RATIOS are a usable sanity reference; its ABSOLUTE values are not a clean baseline, which is exactly why §4.0 forbids them for judgement.

coordinatorCleanMeasurement.note: exclusivity gate passed; this supersedes the 0.60 figure as the BEFORE level

primary._what: the PASS/FAIL criteria: relative drops measured in the SAME conditions (machine, scenario, window length), plus the absolute guards that do NOT depend on the contaminated batch.

p0_instances.note: every scenario, every window; >1 is FAIL. Judged from experiments/probe-instances.mjs, which may only be believed when its `determination` is CAPTURED (a dead detector previously produced instances=0).

p0_applyPerS.note: both: relative drop versus the same-condition BEFORE run, and an absolute ceiling that does not come from the contaminated batch

p0_themeChangePerS.note: derived as applyPerS / liveInstanceCount; only meaningful once p0_instances is verified

p1_rafOver50.note: relative drop of long frames per 2 windows versus the same-condition BEFORE run

p1_rafP50.note: SENTINEL. The baseline is 16.7 ms everywhere; a WORSE p50 is a FAIL even if p99 improves. Absolute on purpose: this is the 'nothing broke' gate, not a 'got better' gate.

p1_nodes.note: a >5% DOM-node difference makes the windows incomparable => INCONCLUSIVE

p1_reconcileRatio.note: instrument sanity, not a performance threshold

reference._what: reported for context and NOT enforced unless the comparison is run with --enforce-reference. Each entry records where its number came from.

recalcOverTask.provenance: audit §4.2, derived from the CONTAMINATED cpuL batch ('from 60.0%'). The coordinator's clean measurement already sits at 31-35%, so the 60%->15% framing does not apply to a clean BEFORE/AFTER pair.

applyShareOfBusy.provenance: audit §4.2, derived from the CONTAMINATED cpuL batch ('from 0.50-0.80').

taskMsPerS.provenance: audit §4.2; relative, but the task denominator carries unrelated work, so it stays advisory until the M-B/M-C separation lands.

rafPerS.provenance: audit §4.2 baseline 35.6-49/s, itself a contended-machine number (a clean page runs ~60/s). Absolute and baseline-derived.

rafP99.provenance: audit §4.2 baseline 50-133 ms, from the contaminated batch.

longTasks.note: audit §4.2 sets no hard threshold because the baseline swings 0-18; reported only.

p2._what: functional regression list - run WITHOUT any probe (no K-C, no K-C', no M-D). experiments/verify-functional.mjs covers the passive part; the rest is a manual checklist.
p2.R3_system_follow: CDP Emulation.setEmulatedMedia prefers-color-scheme flip triggers an apply AND the attribute follows
p2.R4_wallpaper_token: body.style.getPropertyValue('--dsw-alias-bg-base') is byte-identical to the pre-fix value
p2.R5_theme_color_meta: meta[name=theme-color].content is non-empty and a legal CSS colour
p2.R6_token_override_add_remove: setting the wallpaper to none removes the token from body and the UI returns to the opaque base
p2.R7_locale: a language switch must not change colours, and must still work after the fix
p2.R8_settings_row: the Appearance row selection agrees with colorScheme / data-ds-dark-theme
p2.R9_cold_start: a reload paints the same first frame as before the fix

valueFacts._what: measured live by probe-instances.mjs; recorded because they decide whether the alternative (ii-a) implementation would ALSO be value-preserving.
valueFacts.bodyBackgroundRule: body{font-family:...;color:var(--dsw-alias-label-primary, #0f1115);background:var(--dsw-alias-bg-base, #fff)} - located in dsh-web-frontend/dist/assets/index-C6eRlFa6.css. It lives in the SHELL's compiled CSS, not in any */lib/client.js, which is why the first static scan missed it and wrongly concluded the body computes to transparent.
valueFacts.consequence: the body's computed background-color EQUALS the inline token when the token is set, and falls back to #fff when it is absent. So (ii-a) would have been value-preserving in the common case; (ii-b) is value-preserving UNCONDITIONALLY because it reads the computed value itself. The batch keeps (ii-b) on that ground.
